summary: Backend + Frontend auth-gating and IDOR-fix verification for DevicePulse (Emergent Google Auth). Wrote /app/backend/tests/test_auth_and_scoping.py — 35 tests, ALL PASSED (100%). Verified: (1) 15 protected endpoints (auth/me, history, streak, forecast, device/health-trend, reminders GET/PUT, referral GET, referral/invite, streak/freeze, family GET, family/member POST, family/member DELETE, device/clean, device/cache-breakdown) all return 401 without a Bearer token; (2) POST /api/auth/session with bogus session_id returns 401 (Emergent auth service returned 401 as expected); (3) 7 public/simulated endpoints (device/health, storage, duplicates, large-files, battery, security, device/scan) remain OPEN (200) without a token; (4) Seeded a MongoDB user + user_sessions row directly and drove the full protected surface end-to-end — /auth/me returns the seeded user, /device/clean persists and is reflected in /history, family CRUD works, streak+freeze works (first 200, second same-month 400), forecast/health-trend/reminders/referral/cache-breakdown all 200 with the correct shape; (5) IDOR fix confirmed: user A's family member (name 'OnlyForA', id X) is NOT visible to user B's /family; user A's cleanup (reclaimed_mb=111.0) is NOT visible in user B's /history; user B calling DELETE /api/family/member/{X} does NOT delete user A's member (verified by follow-up GET as user A); (6) Expired session (expires_at in past) returns 401; (7) Malformed Authorization headers (missing Bearer prefix, unknown token) return 401. Frontend web preview verified with mobile viewport 390x844: /login renders login-screen and google-login-button with 'Continue with Google' text; navigating to /scan and /settings while unauthenticated redirects to /login (URL confirmed as /login). No React Native red screens. No deprecated Expo packages detected in server.py/AuthContext.tsx/login.tsx. No mocked APIs.
action_items: None required for this scope — auth gating, IDOR fix, expired-session handling, public endpoints, and frontend gating all pass. NOTE: the older /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (from iteration_1) is now partially out of date — several of its tests (e.g. GET /streak/{dev}, POST /streak/{dev}/freeze, /referral/{dev}, /reminders/{dev}, /family/{dev}, /forecast/{dev}, /device/health-trend/{dev}, /device/cache-breakdown?device_id=x, /history?device_id=..., POST /device/clean without auth, family/{dev}/member) reference the pre-auth device_id-in-URL API and will now 404/401. Recommend the main agent either delete that legacy file or migrate its remaining unique assertions (SEC-001 rate limit, SEC-003 platform allowlist, family input validation, referral cap) into the new suite. The new /app/backend/tests/test_auth_and_scoping.py is the authoritative suite going forward.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py DELETE /api/family/member/{id} returns 200 {"removed": id} even when the caller does not own the id (scoped delete_one silently matches 0). Consider returning 404 when delete_one().deleted_count == 0 so a caller can distinguish. Not a security issue (scoping prevents cross-user delete) but is misleading semantically.

server.py get_current_user rejects sessions on expiry, but the DB TTL index (expireAfterSeconds=0 on expires_at) will also purge them — good. Small nit: the TTL index requires expires_at stored as a BSON Date, not an ISO string; current code inserts datetime objects which is correct.

server.py POST /api/auth/logout doesn't require a valid session (no Depends(get_current_user)) — acceptable design (idempotent) but ensure the caller's client always clears the local token regardless of response.
server.py imports emergentintegrations at module load which will crash the whole app if the package is missing/misconfigured; consider lazy import inside /ai/recommendations.
server.py POST /api/device/scan persists to db.scans but is unauthenticated and un-scoped (any client can flood db.scans). Low risk given the payload is tiny, but consider auth-gating or capping.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of gating checks (login screen renders; /scan and /settings both redirect to /login while unauthenticated)

seed_data_creation: Each test fixture inserts a unique TEST_-prefixed user (users) + user_sessions row directly into MongoDB (DB from backend/.env DB_NAME), and cleans up (delete_many) all users/sessions/cleanups/referrals/reminders/freezes/family docs for that user_id after the test. The IDOR test seeds two independent users and cleans up both. The expired-session test seeds a session with expires_at = now - 1d and deletes it in a finally block. No global/shared seeds are written.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth is now Bearer-token based; no device_id in URLs/queries for per-user endpoints. To test protected endpoints without real Google OAuth, seed MongoDB directly (see /app/memory/test_credentials.md and the helpers in /app/backend/tests/test_auth_and_scoping.py::_seed_user_and_session). Backend on http://localhost:8001 (override with BACKEND_TEST_URL). Public endpoints (device/health, storage, duplicates, large-files, battery, security, scan, ai/recommendations) do NOT require auth. AI endpoint has a 10/min per-client-IP rate limit — do not burst it. Frontend web preview: root URL now hits /onboarding on first visit (localStorage-gated); /login is directly navigable and shows testID=login-screen + testID=google-login-button; any /(tabs)/* route redirects to /login while unauthenticated (verified with /scan and /settings). The old backend_test.py from iteration_1 references the pre-auth device_id-in-URL API and is stale — do not rely on it for auth-era regression.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no failures. Emergent Google Auth integration (POST /auth/session ↔ demobackend.emergentagent.com/auth/v1/env/oauth/session-data), Bearer-token session validation, expiry check, per-user data scoping (IDOR fix), and frontend gate (AuthContext + (tabs)/_layout Redirect to /login) all behave as specified.
